headline: Federal agents monitored Minnesota activists
standfirst: New documents reveal a sweeping undercover operation targeted local unions and groups.

steps.text: Federal agents conducted a broad undercover surveillance operation in Minneapolis.

steps.text: Newly released documents expose the scope of this domestic spying campaign.

steps.label: Why it matters

steps.label: What to watch

caption:
Federal surveillance in Minnesota targeted progressive groups and unions according to new documents.

Internal records show that federal agents launched a sweeping undercover operation within the state. This surveillance specifically tracked the activities of labor unions and various progressive organizations. The revelations raise significant questions about the scope of federal oversight on domestic groups.
